$comment: GENERATED from port/types/needt.d.ts by port/tools/validate-fixtures.js — do not edit.

scheduledEnd.description: = scheduledStart + estimatedMinutes (default 30); recomputed by NEEDT.sync, never typed

isFixed.description: NEW — time set by hand, the planner must not move it (was `time`)

blockedBy.description: NEW — task that must close first

holder.description: NEW — who holds the task (a person id)

noSlot.description: NEW — belongs to no day: no rail, not in the unplaced queue

entry.description: NEW — two-minute first step (a one-line field on both task editors; null when cleared)

heat.description: NEW (computed) — 0–1 intensity for the category flame

tone.description: NEW (computed) — legacy accent tone for old block designs

value.description: NEW — money a resale task is worth

movedFrom.description: NEW (computed) — "HH:mm" the scheduler moved it from

age.description: NEW (computed) — days untouched; the title fades past 21

overdue.description: NEW (computed) — past its date and open

chunk.description: minimum work block, minutes; null = don't split

hours.description: which hours the planner may use (default "work")

createdAt.description: NEW — stamped by the desktop task dialog (created on duplicate, updated on every edit)

notes.description: Notes — plain text (newlines kept), the one field both task editors and the focus window write. Older `description` (desktop HTML / phone text) and `note` are folded into it by NEEDT.migrateTask.

ProjectId.description: Seed ids, or "p-<base36>" / "p-<slug>" for the user's own.

IsoTimestamp.description: Full ISO timestamp "2026-10-09T18:01:51.453Z" — trashedAt, createdAt, archivedAt.

TaskSource.description: Where a task came from — the "From …" chip.

color.description: was `hue`; a CSS colour, seeds use var(--hue-*)

icon.description: lucide icon name, was `glyph`; user projects default "folder"

ground.description: NEW — frame tint of the project card

seed.description: NEW (computed) — marks a built-in project; not meant for storage

CssColor.description: A CSS colour value, usually a token reference: "var(--hue-orange)", "#1c1c1c".

hue.description: NEW (computed) — cached project colour for cards

updated.description: NEW (computed) — human labels, should come from the timestamps below

label.description: NEW (computed) — folder line for Template / Shared cards without a project

theme.description: NEW — legacy preset ids an old page still wears (map 1:1 until the first edit)

DocStyle.description: Doc.style — one object (dcSetStyle). Defaults: DC_DEFAULT. Cover is top-level Doc.coverUrl.

DocBlock.description: Doc body block: [kind, text, extra?, fmt?].   p h li quote callout code lead → rich text (p: extra { muted })   todo → rich text, extra true = done · task → title, extra = meta line   table → rows [[cell]] · cards → string[] (legacy demo) · image → data URL / URL ("" = empty)   page → linked doc id · date → label ("Fri 4 Sep"), the ISO day is fmt.date   rule · shot · suggest → no content

RichText.description: A plain string (no marks) or spans.

at.description: a mention: the person's email; the words are "@Name"

Span.description: One run of rich text. Stored canonical (dxNorm): equal neighbours merged, empty spans dropped.

DocBlockExtra.description: slot 3 of a text block: `p` → { muted }; anything else unknown is kept as-is by both editors

task.description: the task made from words in the block

b.description: OLD block-level format, read as marks over the whole text (dxMigrateBlock) and written back as spans

BlockFmt.description: Slot 4 of a block — per-block data (not formatting). In the DB, comments → DocComment table.

Template.description: needt.templates → Template (the user's own; built-ins are code).

HabitCheckin.description: needt.habitCheckins → HabitCheckin; record id = `${habitId}|${date}`. A miss is a missing row.

CalendarEvent.description: needt.events → Event (+ the synced seed C2_EVENTS). All-day: …T00:00 to the next day (end exclusive).

EventTitleOverrides.description: needt.events.titles → EventOverride: event id → title (write back to the provider).

MailThread.description: needt.mail.threads → MailThread. folder null = received; "sent" / "drafts" = the user's own.

pinterestBoardId.description: pins are never stored — only the linked board

url.description: image: data URL / URL (→ an upload URL in the backend); link: the URL

ChatContextChip.description: the chip a question is scoped to (task / doc / day / workspace / project / file)

writeBack.description: Write event changes back to the provider.

mobileTiles.description: Phone menu A's three places (+ "ask"). fallback mobile-nav MN_DEFAULT_TILES ["home","docs","ask"]

sidebarTiles.description: Desktop sidebar places in order. fallback: the sidebar's own layout

calHideDone.description: Hide done tasks in the calendar. fallback false

usage.description: Share anonymous usage data. fallback false

uses.description: What Needt is used for (onboarding). fallback ["work"]

taskSchedOpen.description: Task dialog's scheduling section open. fallback false

Settings.description: needt.settings → UserSettings (a map: each key syncs as its own record). Defaults = stores.jsx SETTINGS_DEFAULTS (shown as
Settings.default:
); keys without a default are set
by a screen and read with a fallback (shown as "fallback"). One writer: needtSettings.set(k, v).

MinutesString.description: Minutes as the select stores them: a string ("30").

Connections.description: needt.connections → Connection: provider id → state (CONN_DEFAULT seeds six)

ConnectionSyncLabels.description: needt.connections.sync → Connection.sync: provider id → "last synced" label (CN_SYNC_SEED)

PlanState.description: needt.plan.state → Subscription.plan (server-owned in the real API)

ai.description: per AI tool: what it may do on this page

DocShareEntry.description: needt.docShare: doc id → its sharing (DocsScreen dcShareBlank).

FocusSession.description: needt.focus.log → FocusSession (append log, last 400; a table in the DB)

writeBack.description: Write event changes back to the provider.

CalendarSyncDef.description: CN_CAL_SYNC — calendar provider → its needtSettings switch and the calendars it shows
